chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Kufi from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Furat ibn al-Ahnaf who said: Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said:
Whoever has an extra garment and knows that a needy believer is in his presence, and he does not give it to him, Allah will throw him headlong into the Hellfire on his nostrils.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of not giving an extra garment to a needy believer when one has it?
ai.summary: Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) teaches that possessing an extra garment while a needy believer is present creates an obligation to give it; failure to do so results in a specific punishment of being thrown headlong into Hellfire. This hadith from *Thawab al-Amal* highlights the concept of *fadd* (surplus) as a trust rather than a privilege, emphasizing the social responsibility of the wealthy in Shia jurisprudence to ensure basic dignity for the poor. The specific imagery of being cast on one's nostrils underscores the severity of neglecting this direct, tangible duty of charity.
